name: Libord Securities Limited
about: Libord Securities Limited engages in investing and trading in securities in India. It offers corporate finance services, including arranging term loans and working capital, inter corporate deposits, ECB/foreign currency loans, short term loans, and lease/hire purchase assistance; bill discounting and placement of commercial paper services; and mortgage loans. The company also provides advisory services comprising merger and acquisition, demergers, takeover, amalgamation, representation to government authorities and regulatory institutions, and arbitration services; transfer pricing, international taxation, and FEMA; advice on import export policy, company law, and income tax; assistance in registration with the Securities and Exchange Board of India and RBI; representing arbitration matters before the arbitrators and clients before various govt authorities; and preparing business modules for the companies. In addition, it advises on cost reduction/financial restructuring; placement of shares and advice on public/rights issues; private equity/venture capital funds; foreign currency convertible bonds; and convertible rupee debentures. Further, the company offers investment banking services, such as equity research, investment in shares, and trading in shares, as well as software advisory services. Libord Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
